response.what_it_is: Motorcycle engine cylinder head and throttle body/carburetor assembly
hidden_risks: Internal wear on cylinder walls, valves, and piston
Functionality of electronic sensors and injector/carburetor components
Condition of threading on bolt holes and spark plug port
Presence of internal cracks or warping from overheating
response.failure_mode: Mistaking specific internal engine parts for a complete running engine or misidentifying the exact motorcycle model compatibility.
